newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks rocket to sixth straight record.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks rocket to sixth straight record.

text.p: Caracas stocks screamed ahead as heavy foreign bidding zeroed in on blue chips, taking the bolsa to its sixth consecutive record high, traders said.
The market's 19-share index gained 5.3 percent to end at 5,450.52 points as 33 million shares traded worth 5.5 billion bolivars ($11.7 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
"Everything makes me think that, technical corrections aside, the rise will only continue," said Incambios broker Adelso Gonzalez.
